name: Wexlab Motion Effects for Elementor
author: wpexpertlab

sections.description:
Wexlab Motion Effects for Elementor is an independent Elementor addon by WP Expert Lab, focused entirely on motion: animated text, image reveals, scroll progress bars, marquees, hover interactions, floating elements and animated buttons.

This is not a general-purpose widget library — every widget in this plugin exists to add motion and interaction to content you already build with Elementor’s native widgets and Flexbox Containers.

Included in the free (Lite) version, 7 widgets:

  • Animated Text — fade, slide, reveal, typing, character and word animation, blur reveal, split text
  • Image Reveal — left, right, top, bottom, circle, diagonal and curtain reveal styles
  • Scroll Progress — a customizable top/bottom/side reading-progress bar
  • Marquee — text, image and logo marquees with speed, direction and pause-on-hover
  • Hover Image — zoom, lift, tilt, overlay, grayscale, blur, brightness/saturation and rotation
  • Floating Element — gentle continuous floating motion for icons, images or text
  • Animated Button — shine, ripple, glow, animated border, lift, pulse, sweep and icon motion

Why you’ll like it

  • No code required — every effect is controlled through native Elementor controls
  • Fully responsive — independent settings for desktop, tablet and mobile
  • Accessible — respects prefers-reduced-motion and never hides content permanently
  • Fast — assets are only loaded on pages that actually use a WPEL widget, no jQuery required

A Pro version is available at https://wpexpertlab.com/ that adds 8 additional widgets: Custom Cursor, Magnetic Element, Text Scramble, 3D Tilt Card, Scroll Reveal, Image Distortion, SVG Draw and Stacked Cards.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wexlab-motion-effects-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP directly from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Edit any page with Elementor, open the widget panel, and look for the “WP Expert Lab” category.
  5. Drag any of the 7 widgets onto your page and configure the Content, Motion Settings and Style tabs.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. All 7 Lite widgets work with the free version of Elementor and support Elementor’s Flexbox Containers.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Scripts and styles are registered, not enqueued — Elementor only loads a widget’s assets on pages where that specific widget is used, and there is no jQuery dependency.

Does it respect users who prefer reduced motion?

Yes. If a visitor’s operating system has “reduce motion” enabled, WPEL widgets skip transform/opacity animation and show content immediately in its final state.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Wexlab Motion Effects for Elementor — Pro adds 8 more widgets (Custom Cursor, Magnetic Element, Text Scramble, 3D Tilt Card, Scroll Reveal, Image Distortion, SVG Draw, Stacked Cards). See https://wpexpertlab.com/.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Fixed a bug where, with both Lite and Pro active, neither plugin registered the 7 shared widgets (each deferred to the other). Pro is now always authoritative for all 15 widgets when active.
  • Added a full “Advanced Style” section (background, border, shadow, opacity, margin, padding, width/max-width, alignment, z-index, transform, hover state) to every widget’s Style tab.

1.0.1

  • Improved Elementor bootstrap: now hooks directly onto elementor/loaded instead of a plugins_loaded timing check, fixing widgets not appearing on some Elementor versions/load orders.
  • Added Requires Plugins: elementor header for correct WordPress dependency handling.
  • Hardened editor/preview detection and widget registration against Elementor internal API changes across major versions.
  • Declared compatibility up to Elementor 4.2.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: 7 motion widgets, WP Expert Lab admin dashboard, full responsive style controls.
